caveats_raw10_4.label: Steinhauer-2014 specificity (no Dornheim 2019 replication encoded)
caveats_raw10_4.detail: Module locks against the Steinhauer 2014 BEC analog Hawking parameters (B_trap=48T, L_h=10um, c_s=48mm/s, T_H=0.5nK). Independent replications (Dornheim 2019, Roy 2019, etc.) use different parameter regimes and are NOT encoded as additional anchor sets. If future closure verification across multiple analog-gravity experiments is needed, the n=6 anchor table would need extension (currently single-experiment hardcoded).

caveats_raw10_4.label: n=6 anchors are heuristic mappings (not derived from QFT-curved-spacetime)
caveats_raw10_4.detail: The four anchors (B_trap=sigma*tau, L_h=sigma-phi, c_s=sigma*tau, T_H=sigma/(tau*n)) are heuristic post-hoc mappings that fit Steinhauer 2014's published values. They are NOT derived from quantum-field-theory-in-curved-spacetime first principles (the actual Hawking formula T_H = hbar*c_s/(4*pi*k_B*L_h) involves dimensional constants whose n=6-closure derivation is left to tabletop-blackhole.md TBHL-01..08, NOT verified by this module). The .hexa verifies arithmetic closure of measured-vs-formula at the locked operating point; it does NOT verify the underlying physics derivation.
